title: Department Scheduling Template — Appointment Scheduling Entry Conditions, Orders, Authorization, Pre-Registration and Interpreter Lead Times
content:
Each **Appointment Scheduling** visit type at Riverbend Regional Health belongs to one department and has its own entry condition. The entry conditions and the per-visit-type figures for orders on file, payer authorization lead time, pre-registration, patient location and in-person interpreter booking are as follows.

## Entry conditions by visit type

| Visit type | Department | Order or referral on which the visit rests |
|---|---|---|
| Primary Care Office Visit | Primary Care | none |
| Telehealth Video Visit | Telehealth | none; established patients of the visiting provider; patient location in Wisconsin at visit time |
| Specialty New-Patient Consultation | Specialty Clinic | referral from a treating provider |
| Diagnostic Imaging Appointment (MRI/CT) | Imaging | signed imaging order |
| Infusion Therapy Chair Appointment | Oncology Infusion | signed treatment plan |
| Pre-Admission Testing Appointment | Pre-Admission Testing | scheduled surgery case |
| Outpatient Procedure Appointment | Surgery Center | surgical case request and consent |

## Requirement figures by visit type

Column meanings:

- **Referral or order must be on file before booking** — whether a referral or order must be on file before the appointment is booked.
- **Authorization lead (business days)** — the number of business days before the appointment by which a required payer authorization must be approved, or the appointment is rescheduled.
- **Pre-registration required** — whether pre-registration (demographics, coverage, consent) must be completed before the visit.
- **Pre-registration deadline (hours)** — the number of hours before the start by which pre-registration must be complete.
- **Patient in Wisconsin during the visit** — whether the patient must be physically in Wisconsin during the visit.
- **Interpreter lead (hours)** — the number of hours before the start by which an in-person interpreter must be booked.

| Visit type | Referral or order on file before booking | Authorization lead (business days) | Pre-registration required | Pre-registration deadline (hours) | Patient in Wisconsin during the visit | Interpreter lead (hours) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Primary Care Office Visit | not required | 0 | no | 0 | not required | 48 |
| Telehealth Video Visit | not required | 0 | no | 0 | required | 24 |
| Specialty New-Patient Consultation | required | 0 | yes | 48 | not required | 48 |
| Diagnostic Imaging Appointment (MRI/CT) | required | 5 | yes | 48 | not required | 48 |
| Infusion Therapy Chair Appointment | required | 7 | yes | 72 | not required | 48 |
| Pre-Admission Testing Appointment | required | 0 | yes | 24 | not required | 48 |
| Outpatient Procedure Appointment | required | 10 | yes | 72 | not required | 72 |

## Points of reference

- **Which visit types need a referral or order on file?** The Specialty New-Patient Consultation, Diagnostic Imaging Appointment (MRI/CT), Infusion Therapy Chair Appointment, Pre-Admission Testing Appointment and Outpatient Procedure Appointment. The Primary Care Office Visit and the Telehealth Video Visit do not.
- **Which visit type requires the patient to be in Wisconsin?** The Telehealth Video Visit only.
- **Which visit types carry a non-zero authorization lead?** The Diagnostic Imaging Appointment (MRI/CT) at 5 business days, the Infusion Therapy Chair Appointment at 7 and the Outpatient Procedure Appointment at 10; the other four carry 0.
- **Where is the interpreter lead longest?** The Outpatient Procedure Appointment, at 72 hours; the Telehealth Video Visit carries 24 hours and every other visit type 48 hours.
